snippet.text:
theorem traverses (h : S.Hierarchy) (he : W.Derivatives S) (hc : commutes W T)
    {x : Points n} (hx : x∈conf _) (q : Fin n → S.Tag) (a : Axis) (k : Fin n) (K : Ortho.Skew) :
    let r := update q k (rise W a (q k))
    D (Points.direction k a) (angular W T q K) x= angular W T r K x := by
  intro r
  let t := Points.direction k a
  let comp (i) := disc (update q i (turns T K (q i)))
  let L (i) (b : Axis) := disc (update q i (rise W b (q i)))
  let y (i) (b) (z : Points n) := factor i b K z • L i b z
  let f (i) z := comp i z + ∑ b, y i b z
  have hu (i : Fin n) b : DifferentiableAt ℝ (L i b) x := (cont_disc h _ hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hh i b : DifferentiableAt ℝ (y i b) x := (factor i b K).differentiableAt.smul (hu i b)
  have hz i : DifferentiableAt ℝ (comp i) x := (cont_disc h _ hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hp i : DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) x := (hz i).add (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun b hb => hh i b)
  have hm (i : Fin n) : D t (f i) x=D t (comp i) x+∑ b, D t (y i b) x := by
    simp only [f,D,fderiv_fun_add (hz i) (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b hb => hh i b)),
      fderiv_fun_sum (fun b hb => hh i b),_root_.sum_apply, _root_.add_apply]
  change fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ i, f i z) x t= _
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i hi => hp i),_root_.sum_apply]; unfold angular
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi
  change D t (f i) x=_; rw [hm]
  by_cases hv : i=k
  · subst i; simp only [r,update_self,update_idem]
    -- derivative comm produces orbital cancel
    have hvb b : D t (y k b) x=(K.val b a) • disc (update q k (rise W b (q k))) x + factor k b K x • disc
        (update q k (rise W b (rise W a (q k)))) x := by
      unfold y
      rw [D_prod _ _ _ x (hu k b)]
      dsimp only [t,L]
      rw [fac,if_pos rfl,fromD W h he hx,update_self, update_idem]; unfold rise
      simp only
      rw [W.abelian h.laws.toSymmetric he h.smooth]
    simp_rw [hvb,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← add_assoc]
    congr 1
    unfold comp; rw [fromD W h he hx,update_self,update_idem]; unfold turns rise; simp only
    simp_rw [← takes,Complex.real_smul]
    rw [← hc _,map_add,map_sum]; simp
  have hu' : r i=q i := update_of_ne hv ..
  rw [hu']; congr 1
  · unfold comp; rw [fromD W h he hx,update_of_ne (Ne.symm hv),update_comm (show k≠i from (Ne.symm hv))] -- order check
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
  unfold y
  rw [D_prod _ _ _ x (hu i b)]
  dsimp only [L,t]; rw [fac,if_neg (Ne.symm hv),zero_smul,zero_add,fromD W h he hx,update_of_ne (Ne.symm hv),update_comm (show k≠i from (Ne.symm hv))]
  rfl

proof_context.conclusion: `traverses` shows the derivative of `angular W T q K` in direction `(k, a)` is the angular sum with the label `q k` replaced by `rise W a (q k)`, using the commutator `commutes`.

lemma jet_line (h : S.Hierarchy) (g : W.Derivatives S) (hc : commutes W T) (K : Ortho.Skew) (q : Fin n → S.Tag)
    (x : Points n) (i b s) (ht : cast x i b s ∈ conf _) (hp : ∀ w, angular W T w K (cast x i b s)=0) (m : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv m (angular W T q K ∘ cast x i b) s=0 := by
  induction m generalizing q with
  | zero => simp [hp]
  | succ m ih =>
    have hx := (conf_open _).mem_nhds ht
    have hu : deriv (angular W T q K ∘ cast x i b) =ᶠ[𝓝 s] angular W T (update q i (rise W b (q i))) K ∘ cast x i b :=
      Eventually.mono (p := fun j => cast x i b j ∈ conf n) ((moves _ _ _ s).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hx)
        fun k hk => (arrow W T h g hc K q _ _ _ _ hk).deriv
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hu.iteratedDeriv_eq (n := m)]
    exact ih _

proof_context.conclusion: `jet_line` shows that if all angular sums vanish at a point of a motion `cast x i b`, every iterated derivative of `angular W T q K ∘ cast x i b` vanishes there.

snippet.text: def F (p : S.Tag × S.Tag) (x : PDE.V) : ℂ := pair p.1 p.2 (lift a b x)

proof_context.conclusion: `F a b p x` is `Φ(t, s) = S(u(t e_a + s e_b), v(0))` in the plane `(a, b)`.

def Q (K : Ortho.Skew) (a : Axis) (p : S.Tag × S.Tag) (x : PDE.V) := pair
  (spin T p.1 K (-Circle.θ x)) (spin T p.2 K (-Circle.θ x)) (Circle.r x • basis a)

proof_context.conclusion: `Q T K a p` is `Ψ`: the pair of `exp(-θ D_K)`-rotated labels (`spin`) at the axial point `r • basis a`.

snippet.text:
lemma htQ (K) (p : S.Tag × S.Tag) : AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (Q T K a p) PDE.side := by
  obtain ⟨⟨d,u⟩,⟨e,v⟩⟩ := p
  intro x hx
  change AnalyticAt ℝ (fun x => E (clock T u K (-Circle.θ x)) (clock T v K (-Circle.θ x)) (Circle.r x • basis a)) x
  simp_rw [stars (sector d) (sector e) (clock T u K _) (clock T v K _)]
  -- need selectively
  apply ContDiffAt.analyticAt; refine ContDiffAt.sum (fun i hi => ?_)
  apply ContDiffAt.sum; intro j hj
  let A : S.Field d →L[ℝ] ℂ := (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((sector (S := S) d).coord i)).restrictScalars ℝ
  let B : S.Field e →L[ℝ] ℂ := (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((sector (S := S) e).coord j)).restrictScalars ℝ
  obtain ⟨hθ,hr⟩ := Circle.uniform hx
  exact ((((A.analyticAt _).comp ((atClock T u K _).comp hθ.neg)).mul
    ((B.analyticAt _).comp ((atClock T v K _).comp hθ.neg))).mul
    ((radial V h ⟨d,sector (S := S) d i⟩ ⟨e,sector (S := S) e j⟩ (Circle.r x) (Circle.pos hx)).comp hr)).contDiffAt

proof_context.conclusion: `htQ` proves `Q` analytic on the half plane `side`, through the matrix coefficient `radial`.

snippet.text:
lemma solves (K) (p : S.Tag × S.Tag) (x : PDE.V) (hx : x∈PDE.side) : PDE.law (left K T) (right K T) (Q T K a) p x=0 := by
  let H := htQ V h T K p
  have hv := Circle.transport ((H x hx).differentiableAt)
  suffices he : HasDerivAt (fun t => Q T K a p (Circle.shift x t))
      (-Q T K a (left K T p) x+-Q T K a (right K T p) x) 0 by
    unfold PDE.law; rw [PDE.vector (show PDE.C (Q T K a p) from fun x hx => (H x hx).contDiffAt) hx, ← Circle.u, hv.unique he]; ring
  clear H hv
  obtain ⟨⟨d,v⟩,⟨e,u⟩⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨hθ,hρ⟩ := Circle.vector hx
  let f (t : ℝ) := Circle.θ (Circle.shift x t)
  let Z (t : ℝ) := -f t
  let r (t : ℝ) := Circle.r (Circle.shift x t)
  have hr : 0 < r 0 := by unfold r;rw [Circle.gone]; exact Circle.pos hx
  let V' := T d K v
  let U' := T e K u
  let X (i) : S.Field d →L[ℝ] ℂ := (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((sector (S := S) d).coord i)).restrictScalars ℝ
  let Y (i) : S.Field e →L[ℝ] ℂ := (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((sector (S := S) e).coord i)).restrictScalars ℝ
  have hy : Z 0= -Circle.θ x := by simp [Z,f]
  have hl : r 0= Circle.r x := by simp [r]
  change HasDerivAt (fun t => E (clock T v K (Z t)) (clock T u K (Z t)) (r t • basis a))
    (- E (clock T V' K (-Circle.θ x)) (clock T u K (-Circle.θ x)) (Circle.r x • basis a)+
       - E (clock T v K (-Circle.θ x)) (clock T U' K (-Circle.θ x)) (Circle.r x • basis a)) 0
  rw [← hy,← hl]
  simp_rw [stars (sector d) (sector e) (clock T _ K _)]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply HasDerivAt.fun_sum; intro i hi; apply HasDerivAt.fun_sum; intro j hj
  have he : HasDerivAt Z (-1) 0 := hθ.neg
  have hw : HasDerivAt (fun t => r t) 0 0 := hρ
  have hh (c : ℕ) (v : S.Field c) : HasDerivAt (fun t => clock T v K (Z t)) (-clock T (T c K v) K (Z 0)) 0 := by
    have hh := (moveClock T v K (Z 0)).scomp 0 he
    simpa only [neg_smul,one_smul,Function.comp_def] using hh
  have hV : HasDerivAt (fun t => X i (clock T v K (Z t))) (- X i (clock T V' K (Z 0))) 0 := by
    have hv := (X i).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 (hh d v)
    simpa only [map_neg, Function.comp_def] using hv
  have hU : HasDerivAt (fun t => Y j (clock T u K (Z t))) (- Y j (clock T U' K (Z 0))) 0 := by
    have hv := (Y j).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 (hh e u)
    simpa only [map_neg,Function.comp_def] using hv
  let g (q : ℝ) := E (sector (S := S) d i) (sector (S := S) e j) (q • basis a)
  have hg : HasDerivAt (g ∘ r) 0 0 := by
    have hA : AnalyticAt ℝ g (r 0) := radial V h ⟨d,_⟩ ⟨e,_⟩ _ hr
    simpa only [zero_smul] using hA.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt.scomp 0 hw
  change HasDerivAt (fun t => (X i (clock T v K (Z t))*Y j (clock T u K (Z t)))*g (r t))
    (-(X i (clock T V' K (Z 0))*Y j (clock T u K (Z 0))*g (r 0))+ -(X i (clock T v K (Z 0))* Y j (clock T U' K (Z 0))*g (r 0))) 0
  convert (hV.mul hU).mul hg using 1 <;> try rfl
  dsimp only [Pi.mul_apply,Function.comp_apply];ring

proof_context.conclusion: `solves` shows `Q` satisfies the angular equation `PDE.law (left K T) (right K T) (Q T K a) p x = 0`.

snippet.text: lemma launch {a b} (K : Ortho.Skew) (p) {t : ℝ} (h : 0<t) : Q T K a p (t,0)=F a b p (t,0) := by simp [Q,F,Circle.θ,Circle.r,lift,h.le]

proof_context.conclusion: `launch` shows `Q = F` on the axis `(t, 0)`, so the difference vanishes there.

theorem realized (h : b≠a) (W : DiffPlan S) (T : SpinRows S) (H : S.Hierarchy) (g : W.Derivatives S)
    (C : commutes W T) (Y : Collinear W T)
    (p : S.Tag × S.Tag) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0<t) :
    let K := Ortho.plane b a
    PDE.tower (PDE.law (left K T) (right K T) (F a b) p) n (t,0)=0 := by
  intro K
  rw [← PDE.actual (f := PDE.law _ _ _ p) (PDE.regular (left K T) (right K T) (fun i => Fu a b H i h) p)
    (x := (t,0)) (show _ from ht) n]; dsimp only
  let z := put a b (t,0)
  have hz y : put a b (t,y)=cast z 0 b y := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [put,lift,z,cast,Points.direction]
  rw [show (fun y => PDE.law _ _ _ p (t,y))= angular W T ![p.1,p.2] K ∘ cast z 0 b from
      funext (fun y => (sigma a b h W T H g p (x := (t,y)) (show _ from ht)).trans (by rw [hz];rfl))]
  have hv : cast z 0 b 0 ∈ conf _ := by rw [start]; exact ranges a b ht h
  refine jet_line W T H g C K _ z 0 b 0 hv (fun w => Y a _ _ _ _ hv ?_) n
  rw [start]; intro i; fin_cases i
  · exact ⟨t,by simp [z,put,lift]⟩
  exact ⟨0,by simp [z,put,lift]⟩

proof_context.conclusion: `realized` shows all jets of the angular law of `F` vanish on the axis, from `Collinear` and `jet_line`.
